mapper.sql: FROM pdm_product p LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) cnt FROM pdm_scheme WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY product_id) s ON s.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) cnt FROM pdm_design_file WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY product_id) f ON f.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) cnt FROM pdm_design_bom WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY product_id) b ON b.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) cnt, MAX(create_time) last_time FROM pdm_change_order WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY product_id) c ON c.product_id = p.product_id

WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productCode}, '%') AND p.material_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%') AND (p.category_id = #{categoryId} OR p.category_id IN (SELECT t.category_id FROM pdm_product_category t WHERE FIND_IN_SET(#{categoryId}, t.ancestors))) AND p.product_status = #{productStatus} AND date_format(p.create_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%y%m%d') AND date_format(p.create_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%y%m%d')
mapper.select:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_code, p.material_name, p.category_id, p.category_name, p.product_status, p.final_date, p.create_time, IFNULL(s.cnt, 0) scheme_count, IFNULL(f.cnt, 0) file_count, IFNULL(b.cnt, 0) bom_count, IFNULL(c.cnt, 0) change_count, c.last_time last_change_time
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) product_count, IFNULL(SUM(s.cnt), 0) scheme_count, IFNULL(SUM(f.cnt), 0) file_count, IFNULL(SUM(b.cnt), 0) bom_count, IFNULL(SUM(c.cnt), 0) change_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pdm_mbom_release WHERE del_flag = '0') release_count
SELECT c.category_name name, COUNT(*) value FROM pdm_product p JOIN pdm_product_category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT product_status name, COUNT(*) value FROM pdm_product WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY product_status

SELECT m.month, IFNULL(s.cnt, 0) schemeCount, IFNULL(f.cnt, 0) fileCount, IFNULL(b.cnt, 0) bomCount, IFNULL(ch.cnt, 0) changeCount FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n MONTH), '%Y-%m') month FROM (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11) nums ) m LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') mk, COUNT(*) cnt FROM pdm_scheme WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH) GROUP BY mk) s ON s.mk = m.month LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') mk, COUNT(*) cnt FROM pdm_design_file WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH) GROUP BY mk) f ON f.mk = m.month LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') mk, COUNT(*) cnt FROM pdm_design_bom WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH) GROUP BY mk) b ON b.mk = m.month LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') mk, COUNT(*) cnt FROM pdm_change_order WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH) GROUP BY mk) ch ON ch.mk = m.month ORDER BY m.month
SELECT change_status name, COUNT(*) value FROM pdm_change_order WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY change_status

SELECT p.material_name name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pdm_scheme s WHERE s.product_id = p.product_id AND s.del_flag = '0') schemeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pdm_design_file f WHERE f.product_id = p.product_id AND f.del_flag = '0') fileCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pdm_design_bom b WHERE b.product_id = p.product_id AND b.del_flag = '0') bomCount FROM pdm_product p WHERE p.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY schemeCount + fileCount + bomCount DESC, p.create_time DESC LIMIT 10
